name: 36078 · Tallassee, AL
findings: ZIP 36078 (Tallassee) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36078 (Tallassee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36078 (Tallassee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36078 (Tallassee) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
